sammendrag: KYSTATS maintains the Kentucky Longitudinal Data System in which the Code Louisville participants have been matched. We maintain a record of such individuals included in this study. Research data are not shared. Data will be maintained for 5 years. Researchers may contact the KYSTATS executive director Matt Berry [email protected] or [email protected] to inquire about replicating or extending these results subject to permission from the data owners. tittel: Evaluation of a new job training program: Code Louisville
